notes: Partition verified: 30 source and 42 target tokens each covered once across 30 units, with no `added` unit.

*the ministers of the sanctuary* is the arthrous case of rule 29: the article on מִקְדָּשׁ takes the *the* standing before its own word and the anarthrous participle takes a supplied one under rule 46.
אֵת before יְהוָה takes the *unto* of *minister unto*, the preposition existing only to attach the object to the English verb (rule 16); the markers in the verse's other clauses are written bare.
לָהֶם is recast as the possessive *their* on *houses*, so the preposition is `unrepresented` and the suffix takes the pronoun (rules 18, 40).
